equity.equity_measurement: Social position is proxied by zip-code-area tertiles from the 2019 American Community Survey (linked area indicators); no person-level race/ethnicity; tertile analysis restricted to aides.

notes: No tests or CIs by design, so procedures are empty; tertiles are quantization. Design inferred as surveillance/descriptive from a voluntary NHSN convenience sample. Job category treated as SES because the article frames it as social position (wages, minority status, marginalization).
